newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia has paid around 2.28 billion riyals ($608 million) in arrears and current dues to suppliers and health ministry personnel, Health Minister Osama bin Abdul-Majid Shobokshi said.
- Taiwanese businessmen signed commercial orders worth $10.6 million in the kingdom.
- A French-Saudi plant to produce paint powder is to be constructed in Saudi Arabia with base capital of seven million riyals, French offical said.
- Saudi Arabia's non-oil exports are expected to reach 24 billion riyals, the paper said, but did not specify in what period.
